title: Learn different scheduling compositions for fresh plans and replay searches
description: Condition the existing arm selector's five direction distributions on the actual search behavior that issued a run: Fresh, PlanReuse, PrefixReplay, or TapeMutation. Keep the existing shared cell, shared exploration-share calculation, learner assignment, rewards, five axes, discount, warmup, and coin-to-all/own-run-to-own credit rule. Inside each CellLearner, add bounded direction evidence for its observed search contexts. A learner draw with at least 24 prior credited observations in its actual context uses context direction posteriors shrunk toward the existing shared direction means; otherwise it uses the existing shared sampler. For direction d, the contextual Beta parameters are 1 + 24 * shared.mean(d) + context.alpha[d] and 1 + 24 * (1 - shared.mean(d)) + context.beta[d]. Compute the existing pairwise-normal leading probabilities from those parameters, multiply by the unchanged coin direction shares, and sample each axis with the existing selector generator. No change to how the shared state decides coin versus learner. Credit the shared and matching context evidence under one existing cell guard; do not credit another context. Each context discounts only its carried directions with the existing DISCOUNT=0.998, as the shared direction evidence does. Add an explicit search-context field to RunAttribution and pass it to choose and observe. GridRun::Fresh, including an unfilled replay slot, is Fresh; a real child is PlanReuse or PrefixReplay according to its actual execution branch. AOS ConfigMutate and initial seeds are Fresh; actual TapeMutate is TapeMutation. Apply the same attribution in existing standalone/curriculum record-and-replay callers. Default callers without reuse to Fresh. This changes how scheduling directions compose with existing search behaviors within the fixed arms; it does not alter the campaign, corpus admission/service, AOS operator bandit, plans, tapes, execution, caps, or run tags. Source scope: simulator/arm_selector.rs, explorer.rs, campaign.rs, util_stats.rs, and directly required tests/export plumbing under spur/.
buildsOn: per-cell factored direction selector with three existing rewards
grid fresh, plan-only and prefix-replay execution branches
rationale: The selector currently uses one direction-evidence pool for a grid configuration even though fresh runs, reused workloads and replayed schedules have different sources of ordering. AOS similarly puts fresh/config-mutated and tape-mutated scenarios in its one non-grid cell. The actual search operator is known before a scheduling direction is selected. A direction can be useful for constructing a fresh prefix but counterproductive while perturbing an inherited one; blending those outcomes estimates a mixture whose composition changes with replay supply and AOS operator allocation. This proposal lets those searches choose different combinations while retaining the shared coin policy and shrinking sparse context evidence toward the current pooled estimate. Existing observations establish that replay fidelity depends strongly on mechanism choices and that selector changes can have opposite grid/AOS effects, but neither proves the proposed context interaction or its sign. The proposal therefore has a modest argument score and a strict normal-horizon supply and predictive-calibration gate. It is not a claim that any recorded AOS regression has been causally explained.
generalityArgument: The conditioning variable is the explorer's own choice to create a scenario, reuse its workload, replay a prefix, or perturb a tape. It uses no protocol role, handler, message name, oracle event, or bug identity. Each existing learner retains its existing generic reward. Every fixed grid arm and AOS can use the mechanism where it actually performs multiple search behaviors; a single-behavior mode still shrinks local evidence toward its shared estimator. The panel must decide whether this compositional specialization helps discovery across protocols.

prediction.mechanism: On the epoch-14 fixed four-grid-arm primary, fresh-session candidate/baseline depth>=8 probability per completed graded run will be in [1.12, 1.30], using the same four arms in each numerator and denominator. Context-specific direction weights should reduce the compromise between constructing new schedules and searching reused schedules. This is a cross-binary prediction, not a treated/untreated within-process ratio. Four independently reset normal 300-second paired chunks are required to claim confirmation. A 12 percent lower edge is deliberately above the recorded approximately 5 percent layout floor; repeated seeds do not eliminate systematic layout uncertainty. Do not infer a primary improvement from whole-campaign throughput or a change in arm mix.
prediction.independentObservable: On a fixed salted 1/16 sample of specialized learner runs, retain pre-execution contextual and shared marginal reward probabilities for the five actual chosen directions. Score both after completion against that learner's actual Boolean reward, before crediting that outcome. For each run use the mean of the five binary log losses, with both sets of probabilities clamped to [1e-12, 1-1e-12]. The ratio of summed contextual loss to summed shared loss will be <=0.98 over four completed paired chunks on the candidate, separately for the fixed grid arms and AOS. This is a prequential predictive diagnostic on the candidate's actual actions, not an off-policy causal estimate or independent treatment contrast. Also compute exact categorical total variation between the contextual and shared direction distributions at every specialized draw: mean over the five axes >=0.05, and at least one categorical argmax differs on >=0.15 of specialized draws. Ties use the existing lowest-index rule. These policy diagnostics do not consume schedule RNG or make a counterfactual run.
prediction.falsifier: Refute the primary prediction if its paired contrast interval lies entirely below 1.12; an interval entirely at or below 1.0 is therefore a refutation. Close as inapplicable if any normal-chunk supply gate fails. Refute the proposed predictive mechanism if the contextual/shared prequential log-loss ratio is >=1.0 on either grid or AOS after four chunks: larger loss is the wrong sign. Ratios above0.98 but below1.0 miss the frozen confirmation target. Close if mean categorical total variation is below0.05 or the changed-argmax share is below0.15 over the normal chunks. Close for any frozen cost, correctness or harm failure. A grid gain accompanied by AOS harm cannot confirm general composition utility.
prediction.treatment: No treatment bit is proposed. ARM_SELECTOR_AXIS=1<<6, ARM_SELECTOR_AXIS_B=1<<5, ARM_SELECTOR_AXIS_C=1<<7 and ARM_SELECTOR_CONCENTRATED=1<<8 name endogenous realized learner choices, not randomized assignment to this mechanism. REPLAY_SLOT=1<<20 and REPLAY_PREFIX=1<<21 still name their existing grid search assignments; none names context specialization on/off, and AOS carries neither. Do not relabel these bits or treat their strata as randomized treatment controls. Protected orchestrator registration remains untouched. This proposal requests an explicit cross-binary exception at admission. A per-run old/new switch is technically possible. Such an experiment with shared adaptive state would measure partial exposure to specialized outcomes; isolated states would additionally halve each policy's learning supply and change the finite-horizon search being tested. The scientific estimand here is the complete coupled context-policy system at the existing normal session supply, including its influence on later direction evidence and AOS search selection. This is a reason to consider cross-binary grading, not a claim that randomized testing is impossible. If that exception is not accepted, reject the proposal in its current form rather than silently changing bit semantics or the experiment.
prediction.supplyGates: Per normal 300-second candidate chunk: specialized_learner_draws>=100000; specialized draws comprise>=0.75 of non-probe learner draws separately in grid and AOS; each actual grid context Fresh, PlanReuse and PrefixReplay contributes>=5000 specialized draws; each actual AOS context Fresh and TapeMutation contributes>=1000 specialized draws. For the prequential sample, at least1000 scored grid runs and100 scored AOS runs per chunk. Export actual context assignment counts, unfilled-slot Fresh counts, warmed/fallback draws and credited runs by context/learner and by grid/AOS, so tags or intended operators cannot substitute for actual supply. Do not lower warmup or these floors after observing supply.
prediction.costClause: Paired cross-binary whole-campaign throughput>=0.97 of baseline, each existing campaign arm throughput>=0.95, and cumulative epoch throughput>=0.90. Fixed-grid and whole-campaign depth>=8 events per explore-second each>=1.08 of baseline for confirmation. AOS depth>=8 per-run probability and per-second rate each>=0.95 of baseline; fixed-grid depth>=6 per-run probability>=0.98. Keep all existing regression/panel requirements. At most four context evidence blocks per existing learner/cell, with only twelve alpha/beta pairs and scalar observation counters in each; fixed-size diagnostic snapshots and no retained per-run corpus are permitted. Report bounded byte cost and created context counts. No new locks, whole-queue scans, extra execution or longer tapes. Log-loss evaluation only on the fixed 1/16 diagnostic sample; the exact TV/argmax counters reuse the direction probability vectors already computed for selection and its shared comparison. Shared hot-path overhead is evaluated cross-binary, not hidden behind selector strata.
implementationConstraints: Preserve the current shared CellLearner update equations, selector cell keys, learner assignment salts, probe exemptions, exploration-share calculation, five categorical schedule-independent draws, and coin-to-all/own-run-to-own reward exposure. Add matching-context updates inside that same permitted credit call. A coin run is never specialized but its actual search context is credited under the existing all-learner rule.

Use actual issuing behavior from GridRun and AOS Operator. A replay slot that runs fresh because the corpus is empty must be Fresh. Do not infer context from run-id arithmetic, realized reward, tape fidelity or outcome. AOS seeds and ConfigMutate are Fresh even if the mutated configuration equals its parent's.

The 24-observation threshold is per context and learner, counting the observations admitted by the existing credit rule. The shared warmup and exploration decision run first. Context evidence may be collected while a shared cell is young, but specialization cannot bypass the shared warmup or convert a coin run into a learner run.

Read shared means, context evidence, and both diagnostic probability vectors in the same cell snapshot. Store any sampled prequential probabilities with the run's selector choice before releasing it for execution. Score against the matching learner reward before that completed outcome is credited; never substitute a later updated posterior or another learner's outcome.

Use the existing direction-visit discount on local alpha/beta and explicit local raw observation count. Contexts update on their own visits, so their effective horizon in total cell runs differs from the shared evidence; this is part of the specified mechanism and a possible source of stale estimates, not a common-clock claim.

Retain existing run_variant semantics and all utilization fields. Add bounded context counters, prequential loss sums/counts, TV sums and changed-argmax counts to the normal utilization export. Reset every new state/counter with the existing session reset. Do not modify the campaign block or any protected file.

Focused deterministic tests cover actual context attribution, sparse-context fallback, contextual posterior formulas, independent context credit, unchanged shared/probe/coin rules, schedule RNG consumption, prequential-before-credit snapshots, session reset and utilization export. They are correctness tests only; use the candidate grader for every performance/effect/supply measurement.

Add search context only to run attribution and selector input/state plus ordinary bounded utilization export. Do not change history rows, trace schema, event accounting, causal ids, reward definitions, ghost_signal bit-based exclusion, execution, campaign configuration/allocation, corpus admission/service, replay cuts, AOS credit or bit registration.

Actual GridRun::Fresh and empty-slot fallback are Fresh; actual child with prefix=false is PlanReuse, actual child with prefix=true is PrefixReplay even if its tape later proves unfaithful. run_recorded forces Fresh for initial seeds/ConfigMutate; the actual TapeMutate branch forces TapeMutation in campaign, standalone AOS and curriculum reuse. A supplied mutated tape remains TapeMutation even if it is empty or has no effective perturbation. Attribute by issuing branch before selection, never by later fidelity or outcome.

Keep at most four fixed context blocks per learner/cell with12 f64 alpha and12 f64 beta values plus a raw u64 observation count per block. Their raw numerical payload is800 bytes per learner/cell; report actual Rust layout including any occupancy markers/padding and live block counts. No maps within a cell or retained per-run dataset. A sampled Choice may carry one fixed ten-f64 diagnostic snapshot and fixed scalar identity fields; report its actual layout and do not retain snapshots after completion.

All local credit takes place inside the existing permitted cell guard, and all draw-time contextual/shared comparisons use one consistent read snapshot. No new locks or broad scans. Export the new firing counter selector_context.specialized_learner_draws and all frozen counts/loss sums/TV/argmax sums through normal utilStats.counters with session reset and flush coverage. Diagnostics use fixed bounded counters and no executed comparison runs.
prediction.posteriorClarification: Freeze an empirical pseudo-posterior, not a claim of independent Bayesian observations. In the assigned learner's one consistent cell snapshot before execution, define shared mu=reward_mass/mass, or0.5 before any mass; As[d]=1+24*mu+shared.alpha[d], Bs[d]=1+24*(1-mu)+shared.beta[d], ms[d]=As[d]/(As[d]+Bs[d]). For the actual issuing context c, Ac[d]=1+24*ms[d]+local[c].alpha[d] and Bc[d]=1+24*(1-ms[d])+local[c].beta[d]; mc[d]=Ac[d]/(Ac[d]+Bc[d]). Shared mass already includes observations in c, so the shared prior and local evidence overlap; do not present these as independent data or calibrated posterior uncertainty. Local evidence starts at zero, and local observations count every credit admitted by the existing coin-to-all/own-run-to-own rule. On each such credit increment only the matching context's raw observations; for each of the five carried d use alpha[c,d]=0.998*alpha[c,d]+r and beta[c,d]=0.998*beta[c,d]+1-r. Other directions/contexts are unchanged. Preserve every shared update exactly. The24 threshold is matching context/learner raw credited runs, not direction visits, distinct directions, positive rewards or pseudo-count mass. Shared warmup and shared coin decision precede it. If that decision selected a learner and context observations>=24, all five axes use contextual parameters; otherwise use the existing shared sampler. Context collection begins with permitted credit even before shared warmup, without changing coin/probe behavior.
prediction.probabilityClarification: For either parameter pair A[d],B[d], v[d]=A[d]*B[d]/((A[d]+B[d])^2*(A[d]+B[d]+1)). For each axis, w[d]=coin_probability(d)*product over j!=d in that axis of existing normal_cdf((m[d]-m[j])/sqrt(v[d]+v[j])). The categorical probability q[d]=w[d]/sum_j w[j] uses the same direction order as the baseline. A nonpositive total retains the existing first-direction fallback; numerical non-finite values fail correctness and may not be silently repaired by another policy. Use precisely the existing selector draw stream and five categorical draws on ordinary positive-weight learner selections, with no schedule RNG consumption. Compute q_shared and q_context from the same pre-execution snapshot. These are action probabilities; they are not reward probabilities. Reward-loss scoring below uses ms and mc for the five directions actually selected under q_context.
prediction.prequentialClarification: Freeze diagnostic membership as run_phase::salted_phase(run_id,0x4354584c4f535331,16)==0 (salt ASCII CTXLOSS1), evaluated only for actual specialized learner draws. No schedule or selector generator draw is consumed by membership. At selection store the assigned learner, actual context, grid/AOS attribution, and ten means {mc[d_a],ms[d_a]} for the actual chosen directions d_a, a=0..4. On successful completion use the actual unchanged Boolean reward r of that stored learner. Before this outcome's credit, add L_context=-(1/5)*sum_a[r*ln(clamp(mc[d_a]))+(1-r)*ln(1-clamp(mc[d_a]))] and the analogous L_shared with ms; clamp means to[1e-12,1-1e-12], natural logs. Other concurrent credits may have happened since selection; never recompute stored predictions from later state. Count one scored run, not five independent rewards. Over four independently reset paired chunks, pool loss SUMS and compute sum(L_context)/sum(L_shared) separately over all scored fixed-grid runs and over all scored AOS runs; require each ratio<=0.98. Report per-chunk, per-context and per-learner sums/counts descriptively as well. Ratios>=1.0 refute the predictive sign; ratios in(0.98,1.0) miss confirmation. This diagnoses marginal reward calibration on actions selected by this candidate. Context base-rate separation alone can improve it, and it neither identifies action-value interactions nor estimates an off-policy causal effect. Failed execution has no invented reward/loss; export sampled-but-unscored counts and apply ordinary correctness failure handling.
prediction.policyDiagnosticClarification: At each specialized draw compute TV_run=(1/5)*sum_a[(1/2)*sum_d_in_axis_a abs(q_context[d]-q_shared[d])]. At final completed horizon meanTV=sum(TV_run)/number_of_specialized_draws must be>=0.05. ChangedArgmax_run is1 if any of the five normalized categorical distributions has a different maximizing direction; the lowest direction index wins each tie. sum(ChangedArgmax_run)/number_of_specialized_draws must be>=0.15. Both frozen gates are pooled over all candidate specialized draws in the normal chunks; also report grid/AOS and per-context strata without substituting a favorable stratum for the aggregate. Count draw-time diagnostics even for subsequently failed runs, but failures retain the normal correctness consequence. These exact distribution comparisons do not require a counterfactual sampled action or execution.
prediction.supplyClarification: Every independently reset normal300-second candidate chunk must separately satisfy all proposed floors: total specialized draws>=100000; specialized/(specialized+shared-fallback learner draws)>=0.75 separately for fixed grid and AOS; specialized draws aggregated over learners>=5000 in each grid context Fresh,PlanReuse,PrefixReplay, and>=1000 in each AOS context Fresh,TapeMutation; successfully scored diagnostic runs>=1000 grid and>=100 AOS. The learner denominator means actual Choice.learner=Some, including cold-context shared fallback, and excludes all coin/probe runs; do not use assigned-to-learner runs as its substitute. Grid population is the four fixed existing grid arms; AOS is its one fixed existing arm. Assignment counts include every issued run and separately identify unfilled-slot Fresh; completed/credited counts and learner-credit counts are distinct because a coin run credits three learners. Export each by actual context, learner and grid/AOS with pooled-cell raw observation gauges. Existing replay/AOS operator totals establish possible traffic, not these new support floors. Any per-chunk supply failure closes as inapplicable; no warmup reduction, post-result context pooling, longer chunk or selective seed replacement. Four chunks are required for confirmation; early close is allowed on frozen applicability/cost/correctness/harm failures. Never describe an early close as confirming a four-chunk predictive result.
prediction.measurementClarification: For each side, fixed-grid depth>=8 per-run probability uses the summed depth>=8 counts and completed graded-run counts of exactly grid,grid-short,grid-no-purgatory,grid-post-fault-2 over the paired completed seeds. Its candidate/baseline ratio is the frozen[1.12,1.30] prediction. The same population is used for the existing primary events/explore-second rate; use the grader's existing exposure convention, unchanged. Report every arm's numerator, denominator and exposure, whole-campaign rates, AOS rates, and baseline-arm-weighted grid rates descriptively. Do not divide grid events/sec by whole-campaign throughput. Keep the proposed1.08 grid/campaign events/sec,0.97 campaign throughput,0.95 each-arm throughput,0.90 cumulative-epoch throughput,0.95 AOS per-run and per-second depth8, and0.98 grid per-run depth6 confirmation guards. Apply guards to cumulative completed paired chunks, show each chunk, and allow early close for a material failed guard; no result can excuse a failed per-chunk supply floor. Existing paired/sequential uncertainty, family dependence and panel/regression rules remain in force. No independent-run confidence interval ignoring adaptive/replay correlation, no endogenous selector-tag treatment contrast, and no retrospective layout normalization. A point outside the specified band misses that quantitative forecast; a larger beneficial effect is logged as such rather than relabeled as band confirmation. The existing graders are read unchanged and any additional frozen diagnostic arithmetic is performed from normal exported artifacts without harness edits.

notes: Blind source review; origin and steering marks ignored. Score and quantitative definitions are frozen before admission. Every new firing/calibration/support quantity remains a prediction; no experiment was run. This candidate is retained behind causal-chain demotion on a net-score tie. Root reports eval70 closing on its frozen evaluator-operation gate, with no speed measurement or merge. Root current-state update is externally reported to this judge; no multiGB parity artifact was loaded.

review.redTeam: The proposed split may learn context base rates, not different useful direction rankings. Successful-prefix parents are selected outcomes, so marginal credit can learn inherited conditions rather than useful child interventions. Direction effects are still confounded by the four other adaptive axes and the broad rewards need not track target depth. Shared evidence includes the local evidence used again in its empirical prior, so apparent certainty is not independent evidence. Sparse contexts and own-visit discounting retain stale minority estimates when AOS allocation or replay supply shifts. The same shared explore-share can become overconfident even when a local context is uncertain. A lower prequential loss can pass solely because replay runs have higher base reward rates; TV and argmax movement can still steer away from violations. Extra probability work under shared guards may lose throughput. Earlier conditional selectors harmed AOS with ample support, though those trials do not directly answer this different conditioning variable.
verifiedEvidence: arm_selector.rs currently has exactly three learners,12 direction marginals over five axes, DISCOUNT0.998 and WARMUP_OBSERVATIONS24. cell keys pool grid configuration indices across campaign grid arms; AOS has its own non-grid cell. Shared reward_mass/mass use every permitted cell observation, while alpha/beta discount only carried directions. choose has no search-context parameter; observe credits coin-to-all/own-to-own and excludes probes. reset clears cell maps.

review.dedupe: Distinct from axis-parent conditional posteriors, successful-vector resampling, campaign-arm pooling and replay-frontier/cut changes. It partitions existing direction evidence by actual issuing search behavior; it does not estimate dependence among scheduling axes or mutate successful joint vectors. This distinction keeps it eligible, but is not evidence of benefit and earns no novelty bonus.
review.costReason: Fixed rubric cost0. The frozen scope adds selector evidence and attribution/statistics plumbing, without core/exec.rs, history.rs, event accounting or linearizability-recording changes. Proposer0.5 is invalid and replaced. Attribution must not silently expand into recording semantics; such a required scope change would need new review and cost2 before implementation.
review.scoreReason: Gain3 is a plausible but thinly evidenced mechanism, not an effect forecast. Verified context availability and pooled estimation establish that the intervention can be implemented. There is no observed context-by-direction usefulness, and a demanding calibration/TV prediction does not supply evidence of the interaction or discovery gain. No gratuitous boost over the proposer argument grade.

crossBinaryException.reason: Explicitly accept an exception to the skill default that otherwise requests a per-run switch whenever technically possible. A randomized old/new draw policy is technically possible and would validly estimate a partial-exposure adaptive system. Shared evidence means it is not the complete all-context-policy versus all-shared-policy estimand; fully isolated policies further split their finite-horizon evidence and search/corpus supply. This candidate targets the complete coupled context-policy system at the unchanged300-second supply, including later evidence and AOS/corpus consequences. That distinct scientific estimand justifies fresh-session cross-binary comparison here. This is a judgment exception, not a technical impossibility claim or an amendment to the skill/harness.
crossBinaryException.limits: Fresh sessions and repeated seeds do not remove systematic binary-layout uncertainty. The1.12 lower edge exceeds the recorded approximately5% floor but does not prove immunity. Report the limitation and all AOS/whole-campaign/cost guards. No bit redefinition, protected file change, hidden dose or isolated-state half-supply substitute.
